reason: 89 dollars a month is a lot when I earn about 27,000 a year and I know Bitrix24 has a free or cheap plan. I would maybe open the trial, but I would not pay in the first month.
objection: I only need contacts and deals, not finance and inventory, and I pay in dollars-equivalent while my clients pay me in so'm. Why pay 89 or 199 when other CRMs cost less and I would have to move all my data by hand?
would_change_my_mind: A cheaper plan with just contacts, deals and Telegram at around 30 to 40 dollars, plus free help moving my data from spreadsheets or amoCRM.
